finding: The proposed joint gate requires AUC, logloss and Brier intervals to favor the candidate under both day and week blocks. Passing supports the joint claim; failing any component does not establish that AUC did not improve. Conversely, better proper scores alone do not establish improved ranking.

existing_fixed_example.interpretation: A frozen, strictly increasing per-fold logit offset can change logloss while preserving within-fold ranks and AUC; these are reused-development point estimates.

classification: Evaluation interpretation limitation, not a proven implementation bug or evidence that extra passes improve outcomes.
recommended_preregistered_reporting: Preserve the existing strict joint gate as a separate comprehensive outcome.
Report the fixed five-minute paired AUC difference and its predeclared day/week intervals separately; report logloss, Brier and TRAIN-prior comparison separately.
If ranking improves but proper scores worsen, report the distinction and consider a separately specified TRAIN-only calibration; do not use later labels to fit or select it.
If only proper scores improve, call it calibration or probability improvement, not directional ranking improvement.
Report 1/15 minutes as fixed secondary outcomes and preserve the same observations, chronology, seed, model state, costs and stops.
Three passes are an intermediate exposure test, not evidence about 30 epochs; neither result proves FLAT, path or net trading edge.
